role_dispositions.inventory: Typed actor/object/place/fixture/domain target; custody-bound ToolReference/CustodyTransfer; snapshot revision vs digest vs authority binding; request vs definition IDs; cap-specific milli measurement and minimum; requirements/checks; positive requested duration vs absolute StrategicMinute and elapsed duration; independent terminal/interruption boundaries and closed completion outcomes; private rejected vs public sanitized plan; private authoritative plan/replan/receipt/idempotence; negotiation social/rank/language/affinity/morale/awareness/score; medical emergency flags.
role_dispositions.disposition: Canonical action IDs share syntax but different namespaces. Snapshot revision, input-content digest and reducer authority binding are different facts despite same numeric/byte storage. ActionCoordinates constructors actually check fixture/target place and duplicate tools; custody constructors check self-containment. Plan/replan checks665-714 retain request/action/authority, complete input provenance, snapshot, requirements/time/calculation; public preview deliberately drops private failed requirements and non-completion reason. Terminal/interruption are independent competing boundaries; tie favors terminal and reaching clock MAX cannot grant completion. Completed flag is derived at public projection, not duplicate authoritative state. Public TimeResolution fields admit arbitrary incoherent clock/duration/outcome records, but actual authoritative plan builder only takes resolve_time output; qualified API-shape candidate, not shown forged runtime plan. Cap milli_value/minimum are broad tag-plus-unit primitives under generic C: use a cap-associated value only if actual capability units differ rather than an arbitrary universal range. Negotiation outputs accepts_demand and offers_surrender answer different questions and must not be merged blindly; raw language0..1, skill0..5, affinity±100, moralepercent/awarenessBPS differ from unnormalized demand score.
role_dispositions.remedy: Preserve existing typed identities and payload enums; encapsulate TimeResolution construction and typed duration operands if extending public consumption. Retain contextual refusal vs unavailable vs allowed reason and private/public separation. Reuse purpose language/affinity/BPS/percentage/skill owners through native assessment, keeping score separate; closed assessment outputs can own required evidence without discarding independent demand/offer semantics. Keep domain-specific rights questions bound to the actual question; previously recorded generic Allowed erasure remains qualified, not closed here.

Keep fractional lot valuation capable of zero, and explicit merchant multiplier separate from fraction owners.
